event.title: Professor Underfunk
event.description: One of the best blues musicians & bassists you'll hear in Texas! Based in San Antonio, Cecil Yancey draws from a wide range of musical influences and an equally extensive background of performance experience. The Professor UnderFunk, Cecil Yancey, is a singer, musician, songwriter from San Antonio Texas. Cecil has been on stage performing since the age of 9 and has 40+ years of professional performance experience. Cecil has just completed the master recordings for his Debut Release "Elephant Tracks" and is gearing up for a promotional tour in support of his new music. Cecil is geared up to provide gaming, video, TV, radio and commercial music and songwriting for Music Supervisors, Ad Agencies and general business productions. His influences and music are reflective of such artist greats as Jimi Hendrix, James Brown, Stevie Wonder, Stevie Ray Vaughn and Marvin Gaye Website

event.title: Grupo Tan Tan
event.description: Experience the roots of conjunto music in its purest form. Grupo Tan Tan (AKA Los Callejeros) returns to Sanchos Cantina & Cocina for a series of shows highlighting the home grown sounds of classic conjunto music in the breeding grounds of a neighborhood cantina. True to the origins of conjunto music Grupo Tan Tan will be playing classic conjunto songs as a trio with the use of accordion, bajosexto, and tololoche. Song lists will include popular polkas, waltzes, huapangos, rancheras, and cumbias by trailblazers and founders of the conjunto genre like Flaco Jimenez, Tony de la Rosa, Nicky Snick Villarreal, Santiago Jimenez, and Steve Jordan. The group will also dive into classic and contemporary norteño, county, oldies, and cumbias that formed the sounds native to San Antonio. These songs will include artists such as Grupo Frontera, Los Tigres de Norte, Vicente Fernandez, Los Tucanes, Ramon Ayala, Anecito Molina, and Johnny Cash. This series of shows is the type of event that anyone who is a lover of culture should not miss and we encourage everyone to bring friends and family as we hope these type of events will help foster a growing appreciation for our unique San Antonio culture. See you on the dance floor!
